title: Dreams of a better world
description:
Price: €345

This painting is an original, one of a kind piece inspired by the way I imagine Terrasen in Throne of Glass, dreamy and bathed in magic. Snowy mountains cradle the horizon while a swan glides across the lake carrying Sam's memory and sacrifice. Capturing only the tender side of Terrasen, this piece becomes a tribute to hope, magic and imagination.
